---

**Platform Details**
- OS & Version: (e.g., macOS 15.1 Apple Silicon / Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64)
- BeamDrop Version: (e.g., v1.3.0)
- Artifact Tested: (e.g., `.dmg` / `.AppImage` / `.deb`)

**Checklist**
- [ ] App launches cleanly and shows QR + 4-digit PIN
- [ ] Phone connects via QR or PIN
- [ ] Video streaming (`206` Range) works smoothly
- [ ] Phone -> PC upload & Batch `.ZIP` download work
- [ ] Window drag, minimize, maximize, and tray work

**Notes**
Any rough edges or errors observed.
